subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with determining where to place the different types of highlights and shadows?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where should a highlight and a cast shadow be placed, if the light source is from the upper right corner?


Solution:

A highlight should be added in a light color, such as tan, to the upper right corner of the image. A cast shadow should be added in a light color, such as light purple, to the lower left corner outside of the image’s outline.


Ask the ninja: 

❓ What colors might be used for the form shadow, bounce light, and terminator on the bowling ball image?


Solution:

A form shadow should be added in a dark color, such as dark purple, to the bottom left corner within the image’s outline. A terminator should be added on top of the form shadow in a color that creates a transition between the shadow and the base color, such as orange. A bounce light should be added in a bright color, such as purple, in the bottom left corner of the image.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where might a highlight be placed inside the finger holes in the bowling ball?


Solution:

A highlight should be added in a light color, such as white, to the black pixel squares in the top right corner of the image.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to modify an original pixel art image!


The light source in the bowling ball image will be coming from the upper right corner of the canvas. The image should have a highlight and a cast shadow that shows this.


The bowling ball image should also have a form shadow, showing where the light would not hit the bowling ball directly, and a terminator, to transition between the shadow and light area. Bounce light should be used to show light bouncing off the ground back onto the object.


A reflection highlight should be used inside each finger hole in the bowling ball image. 


Use the tools in the paint editor to update the bowling ball image!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original pixel art images. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Pixel Artist
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original pixel art assets to be used in a project.

badges.title: Work of Art
badges.description: Create and refine original pixel art images in the MakeCode paint editor.

badges.title: Neat n’ Tidy
badges.description: Create smooth outlines by removing jaggies in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Color Wheel
badges.description: Use analogous or complementary colors to modify the level of contrast in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Add highlights and shadows to make a pixel art image look realistic.

badges.title: I’m Dithering Away!
badges.description: Use dithering to ease the transition between colors in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Up to Scale
badges.description: Create and refine multiple sizes of a pixel art image.
